state.requirement: User explicitly requires primary and secondary to be individual action primitives with text, checked action targets and standardized design. Primary visible card footer/page toolbar; secondary items in owning overflow. Migrate all draft workflows without removing functionality, scope, permissions, evaluation order or canonical form behavior.
verified_mechanisms: Current primary/secondary are bare suites; user rejected this model.
Existing button binding has mutually exclusive action, submit, opens, target; compiler checks these and canonical form lowering prepares input scenarios.
Existing form/edit/delete machinery owns CRUD, protected arguments, fields, validation, confirmation, CSRF, versioning and admission.
Drafts use operation actions, CRUD forms, input forms inside modals/drawers, modal openers, form submit buttons and navigation links.
Draft operations can require user inputs or confirmation.
Custom generated views receive opaque canonical HTML bindings and must preserve them unchanged.
state.constraint: Prefer the smallest complete extension using existing checked execution and owning flows. Do not introduce raw endpoint/callback targets or silently turn navigation/cancellation into mutations.

target_contract.instructions: Select the smallest complete target contract for captioned primary/secondary primitives given these existing checked controls and preservation requirements.

criteria.existing_bindings: Use individual captioned priority primitives with the existing checked exclusive action/submit/opens/target binding choices; operation targets reuse canonical CRUD/scenario/form preparation. Keep ordinary navigation links and existing form definitions when their flow owns content, and standardize priority presentation separately from execution.
criteria.operations_only: Restrict priority primitives to business operation targets only. Retain ordinary buttons for submit, dialog openers and navigation, even when these are visible priority actions in a draft workflow.
criteria.new_target_dsl: Define one new action-target expression language spanning calls, opening panels, submissions and navigation, replacing the existing binding attributes across owners.
criteria.insufficient: Evidence does not permit choosing any of these designs safely.
